suspicions.name: Hugh Bidder
suspicions.reason: His late visit refers to a brass corner post; most other late visitors describe an open cradle. He also mentions earlier salon business.

suspicions.name: Chip Patina
suspicions.reason: A late claimed visit plus conservation access remains worth questioning.

suspicions.name: Artie Ficial
suspicions.reason: Strong motive and a late alibi, but no independent verification.

confusion: Why do so many guests finish with exactly the same sentence about other business? It makes these sound like a template. There appear to be two descriptions of the cabinet, but I do not yet know which is real.
judgment: Hugh is mildly conspicuous because his late story uses the old-looking cabinet. The final production records matter. I cannot eliminate the other late visitors merely from their own statements.
